name: dom-v0-labeling
description: Labeling plan of the DOM experiment (protocol plano/experimento-dom-v0.md section 5, E2.5/E2.6): the frozen corpus (157 pages, data/corpus/frame-v0/snapshot-set, checked by `node tools/corpus/src/cli.mjs verify-lock`) -> extract (FeatureSchema v0) -> the three extractors of section 5.2 as label layers (label.heuristic = Readability.js, label.trafilatura in recall mode, label.defuddle with removeLowScoring false: DESVIOS #11), alignment coverage under 0.9 = abstention -> label.llm routed as the protocol says: TRAIN + VAL by disagreement (divergence, abstention, 15% unanimity control sample, whole page when not readerable or when an extractor abstains on more than 30%), TEST with routing `all` (the 28 audit pages and the 8 draft pages are sent in full: 5.1.3 and 5.1.6). The split is the hash-bucket-v1 contract with salt gp-dom-v0-s10 and ranges 55/70/100 (DESVIOS #13). EVERYTHING HERE IS A DRY RUN: `dry_run` is true, so no call is made, nothing is reserved, no key is read; the stage only prints and reports the routing, chunks and estimated tokens. The model, the prices and the thinking/effort are the vars below: sonnet-5-5 with thinking off is a PLACEHOLDER for the plan (the owner has not chosen the model: DESVIOS #24); scripts/labeling-plan-dom-v0.mjs estimates the three current models. E2.6 with a key and a model is this file with `dry_run` false and the vars of the chosen model, then `gp run pipelines/dom-v0-labeling.json --root <repo root> --budget-usd 25`. A real run also needs the prompt-dev phase to have frozen the prompt (the guide is the pinned file; the output instructions are in packages/labels/src/llm/guide.ts) and the audit to have passed before the TRAIN/VAL routing is paid: run the `llm_test` stage first (`--to llm_test`), then `--from llm_dev`. The prompt-dev pages (human labels from scratch) are settled by the human layer once it exists and are then never routed. Externals point into data/ (page data is never committed); run from a root that has data/ and IDEIAS/ (the guide is read from IDEIAS/plano/, which is private). Needs the Python sidecar of Trafilatura: GP_BASELINES_PYLIBS=<repo>/tools/baselines/.pylibs, and NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384 (the default heap runs out of memory in the Defuddle stage over 157 pages; measured cold run on this corpus: extract 2 s, Readability 23 s, Trafilatura 249 s, Defuddle 1475 s at about 10 GB of RSS, label.llm dry runs 16 s and 66 s; every stage is cached afterwards). Plan outputs: node scripts/labeling-plan-dom-v0.mjs (data/labeling/plan-v0.json, plan-v0.md, queues/*.json).
